name.en: CTG clinic: CTU-UHB intrapartum CTG database
name.hi: CTG क्लिनिक: CTU-UHB इंट्रापार्टम CTG डेटाबेस

ctu-uhb.cite: Chudáček V, Spilka J, Bursa M, et al. Open access intrapartum CTG database. BMC Pregnancy Childbirth. 2014;14:16. Traces decoded from WFDB; features computed by a rule-based script, not an expert annotation.

fetal-planes-db.cite: Burgos-Artizzu XP, Coronado-Gutierrez D, Valenzuela-Alcaraz B, et al. Evaluation of deep convolutional neural networks for automatic classification of common maternal fetal ultrasound planes. Sci Rep. 2020;10:10200. 150 images, resized, top-right corner masked. Teaching points cite the ISUOG Practice Guidelines (mid-trimester scan 2022, fetal CNS 2020, preterm birth 2022).

hc18.cite: van den Heuvel TLA, de Bruijn D, de Korte CL, van Ginneken B. Automated measurement of fetal head circumference using 2D ultrasound images. PLoS ONE. 2018;13(8):e0200412. 100 images, resized. Gestational age from HC by Hadlock FP et al., Radiology 1984;152(2):497-501, checked against a published table.

reviewNote.en: Every lesson, case label, drill and calculator here is drafted from the cited sources and is pending review by an obstetrician and a gynaecologist. For learning, not for patient care.
reviewNote.hi: यहाँ का हर पाठ, केस लेबल, ड्रिल और कैलकुलेटर उद्धृत स्रोतों से तैयार ड्राफ़्ट है और प्रसूति तथा स्त्री रोग विशेषज्ञ की समीक्षा बाकी है। सीखने के लिए, मरीज़ के इलाज के लिए नहीं।
